# GMEOW Images Module

The GMEOW Images Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/images>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/images`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

The Images super-ontology — a layered model for contextual depiction, region encoding, scene graphs, and technical metadata (issue #22). Builds on the WEMI spine (#208): a visual work is a gmeow:Work with workTypeVisual / workTypePhotographic; the digital file is a gmeow:Manifestation (gmeow:MediaObject) plus gmeow:Item / hasCarrier. Colourspace is carried via gmeow:hasReferenceFrame (#70). Rights reuse the #21 facility directly.

LAYERS.
  1. Contextual depiction — the DepictionUsage relator (mirrors NameUsage) and
     the flat gmeow:depicts shortcut (⊑ gmeow:isAbout).
  2. Region encoding — ImageRegion + RegionSelector with an open SelectorType
     value vocabulary (SVG, pixel rectangle, fractional, polygon, RLE, COCO,
     DICOM-SEG, Web Annotation fragment).
  3. Region / UI rendering — IIIF Presentation API 3 projections (Canvas,
     Annotation, selector mapping). No new ontology terms; purely projection.
  4. Spatial context / scene graphs — SceneGraphEdge relator binding two
     ImageRegions with a SceneRelationType value (leftOf, rightOf, inside,
     holding, wearing, etc.).
  5. Hardware / technical metadata — pixelWidth, pixelHeight, imageOrientation,
     captureTime, captureDevice, colourspace (gmeow:colourspace ⊑ gmeow:hasReferenceFrame)
     on MediaObject in documents.ttl.
  6. Provenance / workflow — image-specific eventType values (capture, scanning,
     processing, annotation) in events.ttl; reuse wasGeneratedBy / wasDerivedFrom.
  7. Rights / IP — reuse #21 terms directly.
  8. SEO / discovery — schema.org ImageObject projections.

GOVERNING TENETS.
  * No flat gmeow:depicts as a contact field — it is a formally defined image
    ontology property, subproperty of gmeow:isAbout, domain MediaObject.
  * No primary / preferred depiction (Principle 9). Co-equal depictions coexist;
    a superseded one sets gmeow:displayable false (Principle 10).
  * Selector encoding kinds are an open value vocabulary; actual mask parsing /
    coordinate conversion lives in the solver layer (Principle 12).
  * All alignments are by reference (Principle 5): schema.org, IIIF, W3C Web
    Annotation, W3C EXIF Ontology, XMP, IPTC, CIDOC-CRM/CRMdig.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/images>
